Record Labs 2.0.2

- Home-screen widget: the song playing (or the last one), its artwork, three lines of lyrics and the playback buttons. Long-press the home screen > Widgets > Record Labs
- Sleep timer in the ⋯ menu of the player and the lyrics page: pause after 5 minutes to 2 hours, or at the end of the song
- Drag the mini player up to open the player
- Landscape lyrics: the corner buttons hide after 3 seconds without a touch and come back when you tap the screen
- Landscape player and lyrics open without the header; the \ key on a keyboard brings it back
- The search key on the keyboard now runs the search (on some phones it only closed the keyboard)
- The queue no longer flickers between the portrait and landscape layouts on some screen sizes
